description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'Translation' model within the OpenCart administration system. It provides functions to add, edit, delete, and retrieve translation records from the database, implementing typical CRUD operations and filtering capabilities.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Model class in the Opencart admin design namespace responsible for handling translations in the database.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Creates a new translation record in the database using provided data.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Updates an existing translation record identified by translation_id with new data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specified translation.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Deletes a translation record by its translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a translation record by its translation_id.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of translation records, optionally filtered by store, language, or route.

methods.name: getTotalTranslations
methods.description: Returns the total count of translation records, with optional filters.
